name: deepseek-harness-bridge
description: Control an existing DeepSeek Harness Web session from Codex through MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate Codex tasks to a visible local DSH session.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to an existing loopback DeepSeek Harness Web runtime. It supports deliberate workspace placement, persistent session continuation, search, bounded history and tool activity, forks, permission ceilings, and exact approval or question handoff without automatic responses.
defaultPrompt: List my DeepSeek Harness workspaces and ask where a new task should run.
List the active DeepSeek Harness sessions.
Continue a specific DeepSeek Harness session and wait only for its new result.
Start a read-only DeepSeek Harness task and report any approval request without approving it.
